title: Land accepted work on develop continuously
description:
develop is the continuous-integration branch. Accepted work merges there as soon as it is green; it does not wait on main.

main remains the semantic-release branch. Do not run releases from develop.

Acceptance:
- origin/develop exists
- CI runs on push to develop and main, and on pull requests
- AGENTS.md states this
- The accepted HTTP SSE thin turn is on develop

comments.author: home
comments.text: develop created from main and the accepted HTTP SSE thin turn merged. CI now runs on push to develop and main. AGENTS.md states: integrate on develop, release from main. Closing when that is pushed.
